review_candidates.title: Technology Governance & Strategy Manager
review_candidates.location: El Sheikh Zaid, Al Jizah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: Envision Employment Solutions is currently looking for a Technology Governance & Strategy Manager for one of our partners, a leading Digital Bank! THE ROLE You build the single layer that makes technology spend and vendor performance accountable, end to end. Every vendor contract, every SLA, every dollar spent on external engineering, platforms, or hosting runs through the discipline you set, and how well you run it decides whether the bank scales its technology footprint with control or without it. You own the budget on behalf of the CTO, and you're the one who can defend every number in it. WHAT YOU’LL DO Establish a single oversight layer for technology, embedding governance discipline, strengthening vendor control, and driving end-to-end accountability for all technology spend Own the end-to-end vendor governance lifecycle across all technology vendors, covering performance monitoring Design and run a formal vendor performance management framework, including SLA/KPI definition, scorecarding, quarterly business reviews, and escalation protocols for underperformance Maintain a single source of truth for vendor inventory, contractual commitments, and dependency mapping Produce executive-level technology governance and performance reporting Own the technology budget on behalf of the CTO, building, tracking, and reporting against budget for all external vendor contracts (T&M engineering, platform licensing, infrastructure hosting) Model and track the cost trajectory, identifying and executing cost optimization opportunities within existing vendor contracts (rate benchmarking, utilization review, scope rationalization) without compromising delivery continuity Partner with Finance on capex/opex classification of technology vendor spend and platform licensing commitments Maintain rolling forecast accuracy on vendor spend as an input to overall technology budget planning and board financial reporting WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 7 to 12 years in technology governance, or vendor/sourcing management, including at least 3 to 4 years inside a regulated institution Direct experience managing technology vendor relationships at scale Financial modeling literacy, comfortable building and defending a multi-year cost comparison without needing to be a Finance-grade modeler Precision in written and verbal reporting Some exposure to a build or launch phase specifically, not just steady-state setups, is desirable YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU You'd rather build the governance layer than inherit a spreadsheet nobody trusts You treat a vendor scorecard as a tool for accountability, not a formality to file away You can defend a number in front of a CTO or board, not just produce it You see cost optimization as a discipline, not a one-time exercise You want to build the function that keeps technology spend under control while everything else is moving fast

review_candidates.title: Senior AI Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Persici is a creative agency that designs customized, performance-based campaigns and business solutions for brands across the MENA region. The company partners with clients to build, grow, and expand their brands through strategic, data-informed initiatives. Persici’s services span creative consulting, marketing, and advertising, integrating innovation with measurable results. Team members collaborate across disciplines to deliver impactful brand experiences and long-term value for clients. Role Description The Senior AI Engineer will design, develop, and deploy AI solutions that enhance Persici’s marketing, advertising, and business performance offerings. Day-to-day responsibilities include building and optimizing machine learning models, developing production-grade AI services, and collaborating with creative, marketing, and data teams to translate business needs into technical solutions. The role involves researching and prototyping new AI capabilities, improving existing algorithms, and ensuring robust, scalable software implementations. This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Cairo, with a combination of on-site collaboration and partial work-from-home flexibility. Qualifications Strong foundation in Computer Science with experience in Software Development for production-grade AI systems. Proficiency in Pattern Recognition and Neural Networks, including designing, training, and evaluating models. Hands-on experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially for marketing, content, or customer analytics applications. Advanced skills in Python or similar programming languages, and familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn. Experience deploying AI models to cloud or hybrid environments and integrating them into microservices or APIs. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to work collaboratively with non-technical stakeholders, communicate complex ideas clearly, and adapt solutions to business needs. Prior experience in advertising, marketing technology, or performance-based campaigns is an advantage.
